pages.text: Four barrels lying on their side, $(num)5 x 5$() across and $(num)7$() long, each pointing straight at the core. Their centers are $(num)24$() blocks from the core, so the end facing it is $(num)21$() out. Their bottom layer is level with the bottom of the ring.$(br2)Each one takes $(num)175$() blocks.$(br2)Two more, smaller ones hang over the ring: see $(l:building/axial_stabilizers)Axial Stabilizers$().

pages.name: Stabilizer
pages.text: Shown with the core to the south. The emitter faces the core; the console and breakers face away from it.

pages.title: Block by block
pages.text: $(li)Casing everywhere else$(li)$(item)Stabilizer Emitter$(): middle of the end facing the core$(li)A band of 16 $(item)Stabilizer Coils$() around the barrel, 2 blocks from the far end$(li)$(l:operation/mass)Mass Input Port$(): top, in the middle$(li)$(item)Stabilizer Console$() and $(item)Breaker Panel$(): on the far end, one row up, either side of the middle (console on the left as you face it)

pages.title: Stabilizer Console
pages.text: A command line for this stabilizer. Type $(thing)help$() for the commands, $(thing)status$() for its mass, lens and breakers.$(br2)After a cracked lens, $(thing)lens recalibrate$() fixes it.

pages.title: Breaker Panel
pages.text: Use it to throw the breakers between $(good)NORMAL$() and $(warn)OVERCHARGED$().$(br2)A $(l:safety/failures)disc stall$() can only be jump-started once all four are overcharged. They drop back to normal on their own once the disc spins again.
